context.p: After you install the X-Author for Excel Salesforce packages, you must send your Org ID to Conga. By default, when X-Author for Excel is installed, the lowest level of license is provisioned. After Conga has upgraded functionality in your environments, take the following steps to enable X-Author functionality according to your license:

step.cmd: Click on the Conga X-Author for Excel tab.

step.info: All users connecting to X-Author for Excel are now able to use licensed product features.
